program_name: Sask Sport Indigenous Community Sport Development Grant Program
funder: Sask Sport Inc. / Sask Lotteries Trust Fund for Sport Culture and Recreation
amount_notes: Grants range $1,000-$5,000 per initiative annually. Maximum $25,000 total for organizations working across multiple communities.
organization_types_eligible: Organizations serving First Nations and Metis populations
Minimum one year of operation required
eligibility_criteria: Must serve First Nations or Metis populations in Saskatchewan
Must be incorporated under provincial nonprofit legislation with at least one year of operation
Must serve Indigenous youth in urban, rural, on-reserve, isolated or northern Saskatchewan communities
Application must include letter of support from a recognized community leader
Must outline sustainability plan for programming beyond the funding cycle
exclusions: Organizations without at least one year of operation not eligible
Projects without a community leader letter of support not eligible
notes: ELIGIBILITY RISK FOR EMERGE ACADEMY: Minimum one year of operation required. Emerge Academy is pre-launch. May not qualify until after first year of operations. Saskatchewan-specific. Highly relevant sector alignment. Contact Garett Mathiason at Sask Sport to confirm pre-launch eligibility. Amount is modest ($1K-$5K) but stackable and SK-specific.
